source_caption:
🎬 Aquaman (2018)

Aquaman follows Arthur Curry, a powerful half-human, half-Atlantean who discovers that his extraordinary abilities and royal heritage connect him to the legendary underwater kingdom of Atlantis. Raised on land by his lighthouse keeper father, Arthur has spent much of his life avoiding his responsibilities as the rightful heir to the Atlantean throne. However, when his half-brother King Orm plans to unite the underwater kingdoms and launch a devastating war against the surface world, Arthur is forced to confront his destiny. With the help of the fearless warrior Princess Mera, he embarks on an extraordinary adventure across oceans, ancient ruins, and mysterious underwater civilizations to recover the legendary Trident of Atlan. Along the way, Arthur encounters dangerous enemies, discovers hidden truths about his family, and learns what it truly means to become a king. Starring Jason Momoa, Amber Heard, Patrick Wilson, Nicole Kidman, Willem Dafoe, and Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, the film delivers breathtaking underwater action, spectacular visual effects, unforgettable characters, and an exciting story about family, courage, identity, leadership, and embracing one’s destiny.

🎭 Genre: Action • Adventure • Fantasy • Superhero

⭐ IMDb: 6.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 23m • PG-13

🎥 Director: James Wan

✍️ Writers: David Leslie Johnson-McGoldrick & Will Beall

🎬 Studio: Warner Bros. Pictures • DC Films

📚 Based On: The DC Comics superhero Aquaman, created by Paul Norris and Mort Weisinger.

🌊 Setting: The underwater kingdom of Atlantis and the surface world.

🏆 Box Office: Earned over $1.1 billion worldwide, becoming one of DC’s highest-grossing films.

📺 Where to Watch: Check HBO Max, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming, rental, or purchase availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Aquaman is a 2018 American superhero film based on the DC Comics character Arthur Curry / Aquaman. Produced by DC Films, Warner Bros. Pictures, and The Safran Company, it is the sixth film in the DC Extended Universe (DCEU). The film was directed by James Wan and written by David Leslie Johnson-McGoldrick and Will Beall. Jason Momoa stars as Aquaman, who sets out to lead the underwater kingdom of Atlantis and stop his evil half-brother, King Orm (Patrick Wilson) from uniting the seven underwater kingdoms to destroy the surface world.
